motivation: Observed frozen v2 outputs copied teacher answer/status examples; reviewers approved contradictory drafts. Frozen v2 evidence is preserved.

arms.clean_freeform: Remove all concrete answer and approval examples. Keep v2 freeform adoption gates. Share a corrected default-argument fact card with the guarded arm.
arms.guarded_quotes: Same corrected facts; no concrete examples. Teacher selects one or two exact tool-fact quotes. Strict JSON, schema, current answer/status, plan evidence and quote fidelity gates. Reviewer receives raw facts and draft but no deterministic-check answers, and its separate comparisons are independently checked.

shared_fix: Default value None is not a mutable container; only a verified exact entry guard supports claiming a fresh container per omitted-argument call. This changes facts as well as prompts, so comparisons with v2 are not a pure prompt-only ablation.

suite_roles.cases.regression.json: All old cases are exploratory regression, because prior outputs informed repair. Do not relabel them new unexpected outcomes.
suite_roles.cases.counterexample.json: Eight prospectively frozen, model-unseen stress probes based on known failure mechanisms. No model results are used in their authorship.

model: Use the existing pinned official Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct as a diagnostic, not as the SFT checkpoint or an independently trained agent.
primary_descriptive_measures: raw teacher answer and student-status agreement
raw reviewer approval of a deterministically invalid draft (false approval), even if blocked before delivery
adopted freeform model prose, separately from selected tool quotes
case-specific qualitative correctness after reading actual outputs
success_policy: Do not infer success from JSON validity, rejection of a bad draft, or tool-only fallback. Retain raw failures, refusals and truncations.
immutability: Freeze source/prompts/cases hashes before model runs; new revisions and new output directories are required for any change.
not_performed_here: No real model inference or model-quality result; root schedules actual runs. Scripted unit tests only establish software behavior.
